versions.subject: Merge PR #4993 from @nasbench - Fix Issues
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    OriginalFileName:
        - 'Cmd.EXE'
        - 'cscript.exe'
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
        - 'wscript.exe'
selection_special_chars:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # spacing modifier letters that get auto-replaced
        - 'ˣ' # 0x02E3
        - '˪' # 0x02EA
        - 'ˢ' # 0x02E2
        # Forward slash alternatives
        - '∕' # 0x22FF
        - '⁄' # 0x206F
        # Hyphen alternatives
        - '―' # 0x2015
        - '—' # 0x2014
        # Other
        - '¯'
        - '®'
        - '¶'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") OriginalFileName IN ("Cmd.EXE", "cscript.exe", "PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "wscript.exe") CommandLine IN ("*ˣ*", "*˪*", "*ˢ*", "*∕*", "*⁄*", "*―*", "*—*", "*¯*", "*®*", "*¶*")

versions.subject: Merge PR #5445 from @swachchhanda000 - feat: add coverage for Unicode Space Character Obfuscation
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\powershell_ise.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    OriginalFileName:
        - 'Cmd.EXE'
        - 'cscript.exe'
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'PowerShell_ISE.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
        - 'wscript.exe'
selection_special_chars:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # spacing modifier letters that get auto-replaced
        - 'ˣ' # 0x02E3
        - '˪' # 0x02EA
        - 'ˢ' # 0x02E2
        # Forward slash alternatives
        - '∕' # 0x22FF
        - '⁄' # 0x206F
        # Hyphen alternatives
        - '―' # 0x2015
        - '—' # 0x2014
        # Whitespace that don't work as path separator
        - ' ' # 0x00A0
        # Other
        - '¯'
        - '®'
        - '¶'
        # Unicode whitespace characters
        - '⠀' # Braille Pattern Blank (Unicode: U+2800)
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") OriginalFileName IN ("Cmd.EXE", "cscript.exe", "PowerShell.EXE", "PowerShell_ISE.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "wscript.exe") CommandLine IN ("*ˣ*", "*˪*", "*ˢ*", "*∕*", "*⁄*", "*―*", "*—*", "* *", "*¯*", "*®*", "*¶*", "*⠀*")
